d:
Indulge in the mesmerizing melody of 'Raat Akeli Thi' from the movie Merry Christmas, featuring the enchanting duo Katrina Kaif and Vijay Sethupathi. With soulful vocals by Shilpa Rao and Tushar Joshi, a captivating composition by Pritam, this romantic love song Lyrics Penned by Grover
Song Details :
Song Name : Raat Akeli Thi
Movie: Merry Christmas
Singers - Tushar Joshi, Shilpa Rao
Lyrics - Varun Grover
Music - Pritam
